description: AI image-generation brief for app icon and logo assets. Use the approved scalloped plate-clock reference image as style anchor in every generation.

referenceImage.description: Scalloped ceramic plate clock: glossy cream face, thick wavy forest-green rim, red minute hand at 12, orange hour hand at 10, orange center cap, small green tick marks. Playful minimalist 3D product render.
referenceImage.notes: Attach the approved reference PNG to every generation request.

consistencyRules: Signature shape: scalloped/wavy circular plate silhouette — never replace with a plain circle
Face: glossy cream ceramic, not flat beige
Rim: thick wavy forest green (#2C5F2E) following scalloped edge
Hands: red minute hand (longer, to 12), orange hour hand (shorter, ~10), orange center dot
Mood: playful, fresh, trustworthy food-tech — not corporate bank, not grocery flyer photography
Never add text on icon assets (no StillFresh wordmark on app icons)
Never add realistic food, people, or utensils
Small assets (favicon, notification): simplify tick marks and use bolder shapes
globalNegativePrompt: blurry, noisy, watermark, text, wordmark, tagline, photorealistic food, human hands, broken symmetry, thin rim, flat clip art, busy background, realistic plate of food, utensils, drop shadow on entire square, low resolution, jpeg artifacts, gradient banding

assets.prompt: Square app icon, exactly 1024x1024 pixels, for a food-rescue mobile app called StillFresh. Center a single brand mark matching the reference image: a round scalloped ceramic plate clock viewed straight-on (top-down), with a glossy cream off-white face (#F7FBF9), a thick wavy forest-green rim (#2C5F2E) following the scalloped edge, 12 small dark-green tick marks around the face, a bold red minute hand pointing to 12 o'clock (#E53935), a shorter rounded orange hour hand pointing to 10 o'clock (#F5A623), and a small orange center cap. Style: clean 3D product render, soft studio lighting from top-left, subtle shadow under the plate, minimalist and friendly. Background: solid forest green (#2C5F2E) filling the full square. Keep the plate large but inside a safe margin (~10% padding) so corners are not clipped on phones. No text, no wordmark, no extra decorations.
assets.negativePrompt: transparent background, white background, text, watermark, realistic food photography, thin hands, square mask baked in, rounded app-store corners in image

assets.prompt: Splash screen logo, 1024x1024 PNG, transparent background. Center only the scalloped plate clock mark from the reference: cream glossy face (#F7FBF9), forest-green wavy rim (#2C5F2E), red minute hand at 12 (#E53935), orange hour hand at 10 (#F5A623), orange center, green tick marks. Same glossy ceramic 3D style as reference, soft shadow under plate only. No outer colored square, no text. Logo occupies 55-65% of canvas height. Crisp edges, isolated object.
assets.negativePrompt: solid background, text StillFresh, busy scene, cropped plate, muddy colors, full-bleed green square

assets.prompt: Android adaptive icon foreground layer, 1024x1024 PNG, transparent background outside the logo. StillFresh scalloped plate clock mark perfectly centered. CRITICAL: entire logo including outer scallops must fit inside the center 66% safe circle (Android crops to circle/squircle). Scale logo to ~75% of canvas to avoid edge clipping. Cream face, green wavy rim #2C5F2E, red and orange clock hands, green ticks, glossy ceramic 3D, soft shadow under plate only. No text. Clean alpha channel.
assets.negativePrompt: solid background, logo touching canvas edges, square backdrop, text, extra icons

assets.prompt: Android adaptive icon background layer, 1024x1024 PNG. Flat solid forest green fill #2C5F2E edge to edge. Optional: extremely subtle radial vignette (max 5% darker at edges). No logo, no pattern, no texture, no objects.
assets.negativePrompt: logo, plate, clock, pattern, photograph, strong gradient, noise

alternative.description: Softer variant if foreground plate is busy
alternative.prompt: Flat solid warm off-white #F7FBF9, no objects, seamless fill 1024x1024.

assets.prompt: Android monochrome adaptive icon, 1024x1024 PNG, transparent background. Single-color white silhouette (#FFFFFF) of the StillFresh mark: scalloped plate outer shape plus simplified clock hands (minute hand longer, hour hand shorter, small center dot). Optional: 12 tiny dash tick marks only if they stay bold at small size. No shading, no cream fill, no green rim, no red or orange — pure white shape only. Centered inside 66% safe circle. Clean vector-like edges.
assets.negativePrompt: multicolor, gray, 3D lighting, texture, cream fill, green rim, text, hairline details

postProcessing: Export all PNGs at exact pixel dimensions listed above
Verify transparent assets have clean alpha (no gray fringe)
For icon.png: no transparency — flat #2C5F2E background to edges
For notification-icon.png: flatten to pure white #FFFFFF silhouette only
Place finished files in ./assets/ matching outputFile paths
Consider updating app.json android.adaptiveIcon.backgroundColor from #2ECC71 to #2C5F2E for brand consistency
Consider pointing expo-notifications plugin to assets/notification-icon.png instead of full-color icon.png
